notes.title: Version 1.08
notes.content:
Recent update includes

- Physics Tweaks, boats have less drag through the air and don't hang as much when jumping ramps

- Steering is less sensitive and reacts better when boats are making sharp turns or crashing on the bank.

- Boats are faster (due to less drag resistance)
